<style id="v2-home-continuous">
/* Homepage-only: continuous percentage scale and stable asynchronous feedback. */
.hero-reference { padding-bottom: 6px; }
.hero-updated { white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.static-drawdown {
  --dd-track: #e5ebf1; --dd-progress: #809db8; --dd-tick: #c6d0db;
  --dd-passed: #6e8da8; --dd-label: var(--text-2); --dd-label-passed: #506c86;
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .static-drawdown {
  --dd-track: #2a3441; --dd-progress: #94afc8; --dd-tick: #485868;
  --dd-passed: #a6bdd1; --dd-label: var(--text-secondary); --dd-label-passed: #c3d2df;
}
.static-drawdown #drawdownTrack { height: 6px; margin: 16px 22px 0; }
.drawdown-base, .drawdown-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 999px; }
.drawdown-base { background: var(--dd-track); }
.drawdown-fill {
  background: var(--dd-progress); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center;
  transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
}
.drawdown-ticks { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.drawdown-tick {
  position: absolute; left: var(--node-position); top: 10px; width: 1px; height: 4px;
  background: var(--dd-tick); transition: background-color 200ms ease;
}
.drawdown-tick.is-reached { background: var(--dd-passed); }
.static-drawdown #drawdownMarker {
  inset: 50% auto auto 0; width: 100%; height: 0; pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(var(--marker-position,0%));
  transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), opacity 200ms ease;
}
.static-drawdown #drawdownMarker .static-marker-dot {
  left: 0; top: 0; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--dd-progress);
  border: 2px solid var(--surface); box-shadow: none;
}
.static-drawdown #currentStageName { color: var(--dd-label-passed); }
.static-drawdown #drawdownRangeLabels { display: block; position: relative; margin: 12px 22px 0; min-height: 14px; }
.static-drawdown #drawdownRangeLabels > span {
  position: absolute; left: var(--node-position); top: var(--label-top,0px);
  width: max-content; padding: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: visible;
  transform: translateX(-50%); color: var(--dd-label); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  transition: color 200ms ease;
}
.static-drawdown #drawdownRangeLabels > span.is-reached { color: var(--dd-label-passed); }
.refresh { position: relative; }
.refresh-arrow, .refresh-check {
  position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 500ms ease, transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.3,1.18);
}
.refresh-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
.refresh-check { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.45); }
.refresh[data-refresh-phase="loading"] .refresh-arrow svg { animation: home-refresh-spin 800ms linear infinite; }
.refresh[data-refresh-phase="success"] .refresh-arrow { opacity: 0; transform: scale(.45); }
.refresh[data-refresh-phase="success"] .refresh-check { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
@keyframes home-refresh-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .drawdown-fill, .static-drawdown #drawdownMarker, .refresh-arrow, .refresh-check { transition: none; }
  .refresh[data-refresh-phase="loading"] .refresh-arrow svg { animation: none; }
}
